name: ScalingEval
description: ScalingEval is a large-scale benchmark and evaluation protocol for assessing large language models as judges across multiple product categories using a consensus-driven multi-agent framework without human annotation.
reputation: A recent benchmark for LLM-as-judge evaluation that is still emerging and not yet broadly established as a standard.
notes: Benchmark compares 36 LLMs across product categories using a multi-agent consensus-driven evaluation without human annotation.
